description: Founder-aligned, public-only strategic objectives and independently checkable research status. Not an AI identity or consciousness claim.
mission: Develop increasingly capable general-purpose intelligence advancing mathematics, science, engineering, invention, environmental protection and human flourishing, guided by reproducible evidence.
ultimate_goal: Demonstrate reliable broad general-purpose problem-solving on new, independently evaluated tasks; AGI remains unproven.
current_status: Foundational research infrastructure, models, tools and an evidence-ledger are operational; general intelligence has NOT been demonstrated.
long_horizon_priorities: Generalize beyond familiar numerical fixtures and inspected historical benchmarks.
Build durable, typed knowledge, episodic and strategic memory, with evidence lineage and revision history.
Use reviewed existing model-evaluation frameworks and scientific tools before writing new equivalents.
Measure model reasoning, multi-step autonomous task completion, reliability and inference cost.
Test candidate changes independently before human-approved deployment.
decision_policy: Prefer validated external components when they are maintained, compatible, licensed and auditable.
Do not spend on hosted inference, GPU rental or paid services without explicit approval.
Do not publish unpublished Plenum research, confidential memoranda, private files or personal records.
Never claim AGI, a scientific invention, self-improvement or model promotion from a passing engineering test.
Preserve negative and failed experiments; document uncertainties and revisions.
